capability.description: Name of the skill, tool contract or workflow, the same as its folder name under data/capability-receipts/.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the repo that holds path, such as gabchess/skills. Run git rev-parse in a clone of this repo.

path.description: POSIX path in repo covered by tree_sha, such as skills/content/pillar-planner.

tree_sha.description: Full 40 character tree or blob SHA from git rev-parse HEAD:<path> in a clone of repo. Never a commit SHA.

verified_at.description: UTC time of this state change, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). The receipt with the latest verified_at for a capability wins.

verifier.description: Who ran the capability (ran) or reviewed its output (examined, ready).

evidence.description: What ran on which input and what the run or review showed, with a link to the run or review.
